rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Sports Leader aggregates live sports data from ESPN across 17 sports and 139 leagues via the Model Context Protocol. Its 20 tools cover live scoreboards, boxscores, play-by-play sequences, betting spreads and moneylines, win probability timelines, team rosters, player statistics with splits, injury reports, transaction logs, and league standings. No API authentication is required.
